avis.titre: Really nice kit to try out the brand - definitely saw some improvementsReally nice kit to try out the brand - definitely
avis.texte: I had been interested in trying out Caudalie products for a while, especially as I’m currently on the hunt for a new night cream, so this seemed like the perfect opportunity. The set is nicely packaged and would definitely make a great gift for someone. It includes a full-size container of the firming serum, 15 mL of the cashmere cream, and 5 mL of the eye cream. I’ve been using it as part of my nighttime routine before bed and following the recommendations; first the serum, then the cream and the eye one. I used it pretty much every night for a little over two weeks. All three products spread really easily on the skin and you don’t need very much of it. They feel quite light on the skin and do not leave a greasy feeling at all; it seems to get absorbed pretty quick and yet you can feel the hydration. It does have quite a strong scent coming out of the bottles; I don’t have overly sensitive skin and so this wasn’t a problem for me but perhaps people who have such issues may want to trial the product first at a store. The main thing I noticed over the last couple of weeks is how much softer my skin feels overall; I’m seriously impressed. The main active ingredient is the antioxidant resveratrol, which has demonstrated properties in skincare, as well as hyaluronic acid and vegan collagen. The company claims that it is more effective than retinol, and provides more firmness and ‘lift’ to skin. My skin did in fact feel a bit more firm, and overall a bit more ‘plump’, which I attr

avis.titre: The standard firming cream is slightly heavy for combination skin
avis.texte: This firming and lifting skincare set includes a full-size serum and samples. The core firming and lifting serum uses the brand's exclusive patented ingredients, combining resveratrol, hyaluronic acid, and plant collagen, making it less likely to cause irritation. The set includes multiple products, allowing you to experience a full-size serum and samples of the firming day cream and eye cream in one go, making it an ideal choice for trying or repurchasing this line. The serum, cream, and eye cream are generally described as having a light, non-greasy texture that is quickly absorbed by the skin. After use, skin immediately feels softer, more hydrated, and radiant, appearing healthy. Cons: The standard firming cream is slightly heavy for combination skin; the lighter version is recommended.

avis.titre: A bit pricey but a viable alternative for retinolA bit pricey but a viable alternative for retinol
avis.texte: Caudalie Resveratrolift is positioned as a retinol alternative for people who want firming and anti aging benefits without many of the common side effects associated with retinoids, such as dryness, flaking, irritation, and purging. This line was developed by Caudalie in collaboration with a Harvard affiliated scientist and has been on the market for several years as a gentler, plant based approach to skin firming and elasticity. When the package arrived, the overall presentation was attractive, but there was an immediate concern. The top of the box appeared unsealed and had what looked like a bit of dirt on it. For a product meant to be applied directly to the skin, especially at this price point, that is not reassuring. It raises questions about whether the package had been opened previously. Once opened, however, the products themselves appeared intact and unused, which was somewhat reassuring. The bundle includes three products: the Instant Firming Serum, a travel size Firming Cashmere Cream, and a travel size Firming Eye Gel Cream. The Instant Firming Serum is the primary product and the one positioned as the retinol alternative. It is applied first, directly onto clean skin, and is designed to improve firmness, elasticity, and overall skin texture using resveratrol derived from grapevine shoots, along with peptides and hyaluronic acid. avis.titre: Really good for my aging skin - lovely set to sample it or get travel sized products!
avis.texte: I became a huge fan of Caudalie when I was trying to conceive (bit of an infertility journey), and learned how much stuff the US allows that other countries don't. The brand impressed me with their commitment to quality - and then I tried some products and REALLY got it. I've used Caudalie since my mid-late 20s, which is now 15+ years ago - this line feels really good for my aging skin. The light fragrance is fresh and doesn't linger too long. The absorption is quick but you can see the moisture boost, and my skin feels softer after use so it seems effective! Trying this line as a set is a great value to sample it out - or if you want travel size products.

avis.titre: This skincare system is fantastic for my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have recently discovered Caudalie products, and I love them almost as much as my skin does. I’ve been using the Premier serum, eye cream, and moisturizer for a few months, and my skin is well-balanced and moisturized, and I have noticed a real reduction in fine lines. I have extremely sensitive skin. Almost every product I have tried on my face in the last 15 years has resulted in hives after a few days of usage. I had stopped even trying to find a product that my skin didn’t have a reaction to in recent years. But I am now 53, and my skin has fine lines and some wrinkles starting on my forehead, and smile lines. When I had the opportunity to try Caudalie products, I was hopeful but skeptical. I expected my skin to have the same reaction. But to my surprise, my skin not only has no negative reaction to the products, but it actually likes them! But would it be the entire line, or just the Premier line? When I spotted this Resveratrol serum, moisturizer, and eye cream, I really wanted to try it. I’ve heard good things about the ingredients used and the plumping and anti-aging effects it has on skin. I’ve been using this system in the morning for a few days now, and I like it as much, if not more than the Premier system. It soaks into my skin well, it feels cooling and soothing, and I have noticed that the area under my eyes is less hollow and looks more plump and filled out. Love this set! Great for gifting. Comes with a serum, a moisturizer, and an eye creme. The moisturizer and eye cream are quite small but the serum is full size. Resveratrol seems to be the hot new thing in skincare, I haven't used it long enough to judge it's effectiveness but it definitely seems more gentle on my skin than retinol products that often cause a lot of dryness. The products also smell nice, they have a light pleasant scent that isn't overpowering. Great products, reasonable price although the price would be better if the moisturizer and eye cream were a bit larger.

avis.titre: a beautiful comprehensive set of a gentle yet effective smoothing skincare routine
avis.texte: This beautiful set would make a great gift for any Caudalie lover, but you'll want to keep it for yourself! I love the Resveratrol-Lift serum for its lightweight hydration and almost-zero-texture skin smoothing, and have had it in my regular rotation for a while now. This set includes a full-size serum, plus a small size version of the Cashmere Cream and Eye Gel from the same line. Let's just say that I already have the full size of both products in my cart/wish list already. Rather than harsh actives, this line smooths skin with gentler alternatives and antioxidant resveratrol. For me, it works well for times when I don't want to/can't use actual retinoids or acids but still want to make sure I am keeping up with my skincare. Each of the three products is hydrating without being sticky or greasy, and has the same light scent that I think almost anyone would be okay with. It is a more natural-toned scent than most scented skincare, and at least on me, it doesn't linger for a long time. The hand swatch from top to bottom is: serum, cashmere cream, eye gel. The serum has a very thin, fluid texture, while the cream is thicker/more substantial without being too heavy or greasy at all. The eye gel is less a pure gel texture and more a gel-serum texture; it does not dry to a shiny film like a pure gel would but rather truly absorbs and leaves smooth skin, not "pilling skincare" texture; that is to say, I can do concealer after this and it looks better/smoother, not patchy or pill-y

avis.titre: Firming Help Without Retinol, Lasts 5 Months
avis.texte: I finally got my hands on this Resveratrol-Lift Instant Firming Serum set, and when my friend saw it, she literally screamed. She owns the same exact firming serum, same bottle, and it’s one of her holy grails, so that alone got my attention. I’ve heard people jokingly call this “Botox in a bottle” (that’s an exaggeration), but I will say it genuinely made me feel better about the look of my fine lines. Even though I was already using other skincare, I really do think this helped improve my overall tone and firmness. I layer this on top of my nightly retinoid but if you can’t tolerate retinol at all, I’d then highly recommend this - it’s a strong antioxidant and a great anti-aging helper without the irritation. NOTE: **Resveratrol is not retinol.** As for the rest of the set: Cashmere cream: super rich, very creamy, and a tiny dab goes a long way. I'm not a fan of jars but it is filled to the brim with product. Eye cream: Barely any product, you’d probably have to cut the tube open to get your worth. Yes, it’s pricey. Yes, it has a slight scent (which I actually like). But one bottle, according to my friend said hers last around five months so it's a generous size, it ends up being worth it for 5 months of supply with beautiful results and clear reduction in fine lines as well as being super moisturizing. Makes for an awesome gift, love the combo value!

avis.titre: Good value, and lovely packaging makes for an excellent gift
avis.texte: This Caudalie Resveratrol-Lift holiday set is a genuinely good value, especially since you’re getting a full-size serum plus two travel-size products for less than the individual retail cost. If you already use Caudalie or have been curious about the line, this set makes the price much easier to justify. The packaging is beautiful—elegant, gift-ready, and very much in line with Caudalie’s premium aesthetic. It feels thoughtfully put together and would be an easy holiday gift without any extra wrapping. In terms of quality, the formulas feel refined and well made. Caudalie tends to do lightweight but nourishing textures well, and that’s the case here. The serum and creams have a soft, fresh scent—noticeable but not overpowering—and the moisturizing level is balanced: enough to help with early signs of dryness or dullness without feeling heavy on the skin. After using the set for a bit, I noticed slightly smoother texture and more even tone, though nothing dramatic. These products seem geared toward gradual improvement—supporting firmness and radiance over time rather than delivering an overnight change. Skin feels comfortable and hydrated, and the formulas don’t pill under sunscreen or makeup, which is always appreciated. Overall, the combination of presentation, quality, value, and pleasant textures makes this a strong gift option or a smart way to try the Resveratrol-Lift line. It’s not a miracle kit, but it does offer visible (if subtle) improvement with continued use.

This set is beautifully packaged and feels truly gift-worthy right out of the box. I’ve always loved this French brand because their products consistently feel refined, effective, and well-formulated, and this set definitely lives up to that expectation. All of the products feel high quality and absorb nicely into the skin without feeling heavy or greasy. The two travel-size items are surprisingly generous and pair really well with the serum, making this a very cohesive routine rather than a random assortment of minis. The eye depuffer was the standout for me. I noticed a visible difference almost immediately, especially with puffiness, which is always a concern for me. The serum itself is absorbing beautifully so far and feels very comfortable on the skin. It’s still early, but I’m optimistic and looking forward to seeing longer-term results. Overall, everything feels luxurious and elevated, with a very light, pleasant fragrance that doesn’t overpower. This is a lovely set whether you’re treating yourself or planning to gift it to someone who appreciates quality skincare.

Received this Caudalie 3 piece skincare set and im very pleased with it. Set contains a SERUM/ FACE CREAM/ EYE CREAM. Serum is full sized, other two are tiny. Serum is very very lightweight and has a subtle floral scent. Serum is quickly absorbed and adds some hydration. FACE Cream is richer and thicker and adds alot of hydration. Its probably my favorite of all 3. Cream has the same scent as serum. It leaves skin dewy and non sticky. The hydration from these 2 actually lasts a pretty long time. The eye cream is also very nice and rich and also adds under eye hydration. Overall this trio is definitely effective for adding moisture if used all together. Currently priced at $84.99 its a somewhat fair price for value.. Makes a great gift

avis.titre: High-quality skin care for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: Absolutely one of my favorite brands of all time, I’ve been using their skin care for about 18 years. My skin has never looked so good. I have sensitive dry skin and I must be careful about what I use because if I don’t, I will break out and it will take two weeks for my skin to recover. Now as I’m getting older, I’m finding that I would like more lift in my face and décolletage so I’ve been using this to enhance what I’ve already got. You get so much in that one bottle and those two sample size add-ons are nothing to sneeze at. I’m so happy to have this in my routine and I will keep you guys updated. 10 out of 10 I recommend!

I’ve been using this Caudalie Resveratrol-Lift set for a while now and I’m almost finished with the products, which already says a lot. I only stick with skincare when I truly see results, and this set did not disappoint. The scent is very pleasant and subtle. I’m sensitive to strong fragrances and they often give me headaches, but this one is definitely not overpowering. It feels clean, light, and comfortable to use every day. The firming serum absorbs quickly and makes my skin feel smoother and firmer. The cream is moisturizing without feeling heavy, and my skin looks more plump and healthy. The eye cream is gentle and hydrating, leaving the eye area looking refreshed. Overall, this is a high-quality, effective set that delivers visible results without a strong fragrance. I would definitely repurchase and recommend it, especially for anyone who prefers mild-scented skincare.

This Caudalie Resveratrol-Lift Lift & Firm Essentials set is amazing. The serum is the perfect texture and melts into my skin giving it a bright and lifted look. It does have a scent that is common for all of Caudalie products, but it’s not a super heavy one and I like it. The mini eye and skin cream are both amazing and I will buy them again for sure. The cream is thick and absorbs well and it played nice as a base layer for my makeup and as a night cream but I loved it on my neck the most. The eye cream passed my sensitive eye check and my lids and under eye area feel moisturized and I look well rested.

I am loving this set! Caudalie makes great skincare and this set does not disappoint! It goes on so smooth and absorbs easily, leaving my skin soft and hydrated. It has a light, fresh scent too. I have oily skin and this does not add to that issue or cauae breakouts. Perfect for winter skin. My skin is so happy, and I can't wait to see long term results!

This giftset comes with a full-size serum, and travel size facial cream and eye cream. All 3 have the classic Caudalie scent, it's a unique pleasant scent, I thought it was odd at first but it grew on me. The serum comes in a pump bottle, it's a bit runny but it stays on your hand. It absorbs well to the skin and gives the skin a tighter look. The cream is a bit thicker but not too thick, it feels like a light lotion. It goes well with the serum and keeps the skin hydrated. The eye cream has the same runny texture as the serum, it's small container but you don't need to use a lot. The 3 products work together well, and they can become part of your skincare routine. I like how youthful the skin looks in the morning after use them. It's a good set and a good way to try out their products. I will be getting these in full size
